A Boy From Texas
Count: 32  Wall: 4  Level: Improver
Choreo: Rob Holley (US). March 2024
Music: Texas Hold 'em - Nicolle Galyon

Starts after 16 counts

SEC 1 BACK, HOLD, COASTER CROSS, SIDE, HOLD, ¼ TURN SAILOR
1-2 Step right back, drag left next to right
3&4 Step left back, step right next to left, cross left over right
5-6 Step right to right side, drag left next to right
7&8 Turn ¼ left step left back, step right to right side, step left to left side (9:00)

SEC 2 SAILOR STEP, BEHIND, ¼ TURN STEP, STEP, PRISSY WALK, HOLD, PRISSY WALK, HOLD
1&2 Step right behind left, step left to left side, step right to right side
3&4 Step left behind right, turn ¼ right step right forward, step left forward (12:00)
5-6 Step right forward, hold
7-8 Step left forward, hold

SEC 3 ROCK, RECOVER, ½ TURN SHUFFLE, ROCK, RECOVER, SHUFFLE BACK
1-2 Rock right forward, recover weight on left
3&4 Turn ½ right step right forward, step right next to left, step right forward (6:00)
5-6 Rock left forward, recover weight on right
7&8 Step left back, step right next to left, step left back

Restart Here on Wall 7

SEC 4 BACK, POINT, STEP, POINT, CROSS SAMBA STEP, ¼ TURN SAMBA STEP
1-2 Step right back, point left to left side
3-4 Step left forward, point right to right side
5&6 Cross right over left, step left back, step right next to left
7&8 Cross left over right, turn ¼ left step right back, step left back (3:00)

Tag At the end of Wall 1
REVERSE ROCKING CHAIR
1-2 Rock right back, recover weight on left
3-4 Rock right forward, recover weight on left
